title: Ethiopian Regional Diversity Platter
localName: ሁሉም ኢትዮጵያ ምግብ — All Ethiopia Platter
community: All of Ethiopia — the complete regional diversity
author: Chef Haile
desc: All Ethiopia Platter — representing every major region: Amhara Tibs (ETH231), Tigrayan Zigni (ETH235), Tigrayan Tihlo (ETH236), Oromo Marqa (ETH233), Gurage Kitfo (ETH237), Sidama Chuko (ETH238), Harari Fah-Fah (ETH240), Anuak Fish (ETH246), and the Grand Fasting Beyaynetu (ETH140). Ethiopia's 80+ ethnic food traditions on one table.
longDesc: The All Ethiopia Platter is the ultimate expression of Ethiopian food diversity — 80+ ethnic groups, five major religion traditions, twelve ecoregions, and thousands of years of culinary history assembled on one grand celebration table.
steps: 3 days before: Tej, Tella, Key Wat.
2 days before: Oromo Marqa, Harari Fah-Fah.
1 day before: Tigrayan Zigni, all fasting dishes.
Day of: Tihlo, Kitfo, Amhara Tibs, Anuak Fish — all fresh.
chefTips: This is the feast of Ethiopia — 3 days of preparation minimum.
The diversity is the message — serve all dishes simultaneously so guests can explore.
sustainabilityTips: Ethiopia has over 80 ethnic groups — the All Ethiopia Platter celebrates biodiversity at every level: culinary, agricultural, and cultural.
servedWith: With the coffee ceremony concluding the feast
healthBenefits: The All Ethiopia Platter provides the most nutritionally diverse single meal available in African cuisine.
culturalNote: The All Ethiopia Platter is the statement that Ethiopia is not one food culture but many — that the berbere-and-injera tradition of the highlands is only one chapter in a food story that includes enset from the south, camel from the east, river fish from the west, and barley beer from ancient Tigray. Ethiopia is one of the most food-culturally diverse nations on earth.
